title: EligibilitySnapshotEvidenceV1
description: Shape IVR expects inside the Target V1 task field `eligibility_snapshot` (W-0030 / prompt P4-2). This is a LINKED EVIDENCE REFERENCE, not a wire contract: `eligibility_snapshot` stays an open object in specs/api/openapi/ivr-order-confirmation.v1.yaml because its shape is not owner-approved yet (OD-V1-03, closure ticket docs/contracts/target-v1-closure-pack/T-02-task-data-order-version.md). M3 owns business call selection before task intake. IVR validates source, timing, blockers and transactional voice safety FAIL-CLOSED, but never reads customer trust or order risk metadata to reverse M3's call instruction (OD-18).

decision.description: Sales' own eligibility verdict for this order. IVR dispatches only on the exact value `ELIGIBLE`. `BLOCKED`, `NOT_ELIGIBLE` and `INELIGIBLE` are treated as an operational block. Any other value, including a missing one, holds the task for admin review rather than guessing — an unrecognised verdict is not a permissive one.

source_version.description: Version of the Sales evidence source that produced this snapshot. Required by IVR policy: without it, a snapshot cannot be attributed to a known producer, and a later dispute cannot be resolved. Absent or blank holds the task.

captured_at.description: When Sales captured the evidence. Must fall inside [confirmation_window_started_at, evaluation time]. Earlier means the evidence describes a different order state; later means a clock or producer defect. Both hold the task.

source_available.description: False when Sales could not reach its own evidence source and is telling IVR so explicitly. Absent is read as true. A present-but-non-boolean value is read as false, because a producer defect here must not resolve to 'available'.

blockers.description: Privacy-safe blocker codes Sales is aware of. A non-empty list blocks dispatch EVEN WHEN `decision` is `ELIGIBLE`: trusting the summary field over the detail would place a call on an order Sales itself flagged. Codes must carry no customer data — they travel into IVR evidence and admin screens.

voice_restriction.description: Provenance for the TRANSACTIONAL VOICE decision (W-0031 / P4-3). The task field `call_restriction` stays authoritative for the verdict; this object adds the source facts the wire contract cannot carry yet. IVR reads exactly the three keys below and nothing else from this object.

restricted.description: True blocks dispatch. Absent falls back to the task field `call_restriction`. Neither absent nor unresolved may ever read as permission.

source_available.description: False means the voice-restriction resolver could not answer. IVR HOLDS the task: 'the resolver could not answer' is not permission to call.

source_version.description: Version of the resolver that produced the verdict. Falls back to the snapshot-level `source_version` when absent, since the voice decision belongs to the same evidence capture.

trust.description: LEGACY_READ compatibility object retained so older M3 producers can roll alongside OD-18. Active IVR eligibility ignores this entire object. New producers should omit it; M3 decides no-call cases before task intake.

risk_evidence_available.description: LEGACY_READ compatibility value. True, false and absence are all ignored by active IVR eligibility under OD-18.

resolver_version.description: LEGACY_READ audit value; ignored by active IVR eligibility.

resolver_available.description: LEGACY_READ audit value; ignored by active IVR eligibility.

examples.$comment: LEGACY_READ compatibility example from OD-15. Under OD-18 the trust object is accepted but ignored; this valid M3 task remains call-required after IVR safety gates.

x-ivr-fail-closed-order: ELIGIBILITY_SNAPSHOT_UNREADABLE — something was sent that IVR cannot interpret
ELIGIBILITY_SNAPSHOT_STALE — captured_at absent or outside the confirmation window
ELIGIBILITY_SNAPSHOT_BLOCKED / ELIGIBILITY_SNAPSHOT_UNKNOWN — decision is not ELIGIBLE
ELIGIBILITY_SNAPSHOT_BLOCKED — decision is ELIGIBLE but blockers is non-empty

x-ivr-fail-closed-directions.voice_restriction: Closes toward BLOCKING. Restricted, unknown and source-unavailable all stop the dispatch — not knowing whether we may call a customer must never resolve to calling them. Reason codes: PHONE_CALL_RESTRICTION_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, PHONE_CALL_RESTRICTION_MISSING, PHONE_CALL_RESTRICTED.
x-ivr-fail-closed-directions.trust: LEGACY_READ only. Active IVR ignores trust metadata and never uses it to decide call/skip; M3 owns that business decision before task intake.
x-ivr-fail-closed-directions.why-the-separation: Transactional voice restriction remains an IVR safety gate. Customer trust/order risk is M3 business selection metadata and cannot override a task M3 already selected for calling.

x-ivr-notes.marketing-consent-separation: IVR reads no SMS, email, marketing-consent, newsletter or promo key from this bag, and the domain type carrying the voice decision has no field that could hold one. A customer who declined marketing has not declined a transactional order-confirmation call; the two rest on different legal bases. Sales may include such keys — they are ignored, and a test drives a bag containing all of them to prove the outcome does not change.
x-ivr-notes.structural-before-content: Structural failures are reported before content failures so the reason code names the real defect. A snapshot IVR could not read must never surface as a decision IVR disagrees with.
x-ivr-notes.immutability: At intake IVR stores the snapshot verbatim and records a SHA-256 digest of it in ivr_confirmation_tasks.eligibility_snapshot_hash, constrained to lowercase hex. The digest — never the body — is carried into the eligibility evaluation evidence refs so a result callback can be traced to the exact evidence the decision was made on.
x-ivr-notes.not-an-ops-client: IVR consumes this evidence only. It holds no Ops credential, client or webhook, and never writes order state (D-02). recommended_core_action on the outbound callback stays advisory.
x-ivr-notes.m3-authority: OD-18: M3 sends only call-required orders. IVR validates technical and safety preconditions, executes the call, and returns a result signal; it does not classify old/new customers.
